metadata.note: This is the 'compressed' Collatz map T_c often used in the literature: it folds the obligatory n+1 -> (3n+1)/2 step (since 3n+1 is even when n is odd) into a single bit-level operation. T_c reaches 1 iff T reaches 1; cycles transfer. Used as a step-count optimization, not a structural proof step. Mismatch in examples: T(7)=22, T_c(7)=11 -- they agree only on even arguments.
